quote.text: Gratitude is not only the greatest of virtues, but the parent of all the others.

title: This Thanksgiving, I'm grateful for…
body: It was a year of small mercies, and I don't want them to slip by unnoticed.

items.subject: My sister
items.why: for the Sunday calls that never once felt like a chore.
items.difference: I came out of a heavy year steadier than I went in.
items.forward: I've started calling Dad every Sunday too.

items.subject: The people I get to work with
items.why: for building something hard together and still laughing at the end of it.
items.difference: They reminded me that good work is mostly good people.
items.forward: I'm keeping an hour every week to help a new engineer find their feet.

items.subject: Ordinary evenings at home
items.why: for dinners that run late and homework at the kitchen table.
items.difference: They're the part of the day I'd keep if I could keep only one.
items.forward: This winter we'll cook for our neighbour once a week.

closing: May I notice these things more often, and pass a little of each one on.

photo.caption: Tea by the window, late November
photo.alt: Pencil sketch of a steaming cup on a windowsill, with an autumn tree and falling leaves outside
